verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM has a dedicated first-party docs section, "MCP Compatibility in AnythingLLM" (docs-20), and the probe confirms that page exists (probe-3). For an agent-capable assistant, this indicates it can plug in MCP servers as tools, but the evidence is only a page title with no detail. Missing for 10: details on how MCP servers are configured (stdio/SSE/HTTP transports), confirmation that agents can invoke MCP tools, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the integration works.
